title: What 6 month of development looks like
author: Snoo-29395
selftext:
I know there is a lot of AI hate nowadays, and mostly due to the one prompt people spamming social media.

There are a lot of things wrong and i need to polish a lot, but i've been using AI to help me designing the architecture of the game, solely on coding, and after a lot of iteration this is the result after 6 month of grinding, learning and iterating a lot (+ a lot of royalty free assets). I've been learning 3d modeling, animation, etc for over 4 years, and i've been a software dev for almost 9 years now, and thanks to the AI i can now find the motivation and courage to make a game i'm not too ashamed to show, even if there's a long road ahead to release a demo.

So, to the people out there willing to make something, is not as easy as others tell but is really rewarding.

In case anyone wants to support, here's the link to me steam page  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042810/NullGate/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042810/NullGate/)
